brief: Reassess contributions when income changes while preserving near-term essential obligations.

title.es-MX: Ajusta aportaciones si cambia el ingreso
title.pt-BR: Ajuste aportes se a renda mudar

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Adjust Contributions"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Ajusta aportaciones si cambia el ingreso"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Ajuste aportes se a renda mudar"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Reassess contributions when income changes while preserving near-term essential obligations.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: A long-term contribution plan must still fit the essential payments due now.
instruction.misconception: Maintaining the original contribution at any cost is always preferable to reassessing changed income and essential obligations.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use only the visible fictional amounts and conditions; earlier arithmetic is preparation, not a hidden financial assumption.

evidence.reasoning: Income falls but essentials remain due. Recalculate available money before maintaining a contribution that would leave those payments uncovered.
The contribution must fit actual resources and essential obligations.
An unconfirmed receipt cannot support a fixed current commitment.
The plan’s terms can affect the consequences of an adjustment.
A changed income can justify another deliberate review.
Borrowing adds repayment obligations rather than removing the resource gap.
The new plan must reflect reduced resources and actual needs.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.
